questions.stem: The students were reading ____ the teacher came in.

options.distractor: came in 是瞬间动作，不能用 while
老师进来时他们已经在读了

questions.explanation: came in 是瞬间动作，只能用 when。

questions.stem: ____ Tom was doing his homework, his sister was drawing.

options.distractor: 两个动作同时进行，用 While 更贴切
这里没有因果或结果关系

questions.explanation: 两个动作都是过去进行时、同时进行，用 While。

questions.stem: I met an old friend ____ I ____ (walk) in the park.

options.distractor: 走路是持续动作，要用进行时
while 后面通常接持续动作（进行时）
when 也能接进行时，但这里强调“散步过程中”，while 最贴切

questions.explanation: “在散步的过程中遇见”，长动作用 while + was walking。

questions.stem: ____ the rain stopped, we were still working in the fields.

options.distractor: stopped 是瞬间动作，不能用 while
during 后面接名词，不接句子

options.text: When I saw him, he was running.
While we were talking, the bell rang.
While he arrived, we were having dinner.
When the phone rang, she was cooking.

questions.explanation: arrived 是瞬间动作，应改为 When he arrived, we were having dinner。

questions.stem: ____ I ____ (wait) for the bus, I saw a traffic accident.

options.distractor: 等车是持续动作，要用进行时
while 后面通常接进行时

questions.explanation: “等车的过程中看见”，用 While I was waiting。
